title: Apple vs 1000 Cuts #satisfying #oddlysatisfying #asmr
description:
One apple, six rounds: 10 → 50 → 100 → 240 → 500 → 1,000 cuts. By the final round it's about 19.9 million cubes.
Fully 3D-animated, with original close-up cutting sound design.
